description_en: Queries the engine and kernel properties of an instance
description_zh: 查询实例引擎和内核属性
name: GetInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The cloud product type identifier. Valid values:

5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2.

If you specify both ProductId and ProductCode, the values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If you also specify ProductId, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId in the response of the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

CurrentKernelVersion.description_en: The current kernel version of the instance

EngineVersion.description_en: The major version of the database engine

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code for the record or operation. This value can be empty if no error occurs. Evaluate this value together with ErrorMessage
ErrorCode.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误码。无错误时可为空；应结合 ErrorMessage 判断

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error message for the record or operation
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误说明

KmsEncryptionSupported.description_en: Indicates whether the instance supports column encryption by using KMS keys
KmsEncryptionSupported.description_zh: 实例是否支持使用 KMS 密钥进行列加密

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O&M window. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. The UTC time of the O&M window is combined with the date of the query day and returned
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 维护窗口结束时刻。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。将维护窗口的 UTC 时刻与查询当日日期组合后返回

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O&M window. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. The UTC time of the O&M window is combined with the date of the query day and returned
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 维护窗口开始时刻。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。将维护窗口的 UTC 时刻与查询当日日期组合后返回

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

Status.description_en: The current running status of the instance
